column1: # Single-app "max-blocklist" layout for 4MB flash: one firmware slot (NO
# firmware OTA rollback) + a fat LittleFS for the blocklist.
# Firmware updates on this layout are done over USB (esptool / PlatformIO /
# web flasher reflash). Blocklist updates still work over WiFi (dashboard
# upload + remote auto-update) for lists that fit the staging window.
# Layout: factory app 1.25MB (~200KB headroom over the ~1.10MB build)
# LittleFS ~2.75MB (~540k domains with the 128KB bloom; the 537k "ultimate"
# list fits a single copy but NOT a live+staging pair
